en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing the entrance to a seaside bath complex. In the foreground is a curved staircase with railings and decorative planters with palm trees on both sides; a tall ornate street lamp stands to the left and right. Beyond the stairs is a symmetrical, flat‑roofed building facing the sea, with several windows and a central section topped by a mast and a sign. At the bottom margin, captions in Bulgarian and French identify the place as the sea baths in Varna and note that this is the entrance.
